_what: M3 prompt-arm comparison, held-out own-account set. Measurement only - nothing here is in the database.
_why_committed: Without this the M3 evaluation is not reproducible: the labels were committed and the predictions were not, so every figure in docs/benchmarks/6c-vision-benchmark.md rested on a file in a temporary directory. scripts/provision/score_m3_arms.py re-derives the whole benchmark from this file plus the matching label fixture, and tests/server/test_vision_promotion.py recomputes the promoted fields from it independently.
_contains_no_media: Model answers and token counts only. No frames, no bytes. The competitor frames these came from were deleted under ADR 0009 and cannot be regenerated without re-acquiring the media.
